certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Official Iowa Secretary of State 2024 General Election canvass summary PDF. County candidate totals are parsed from the President and Vice President Total rows and reconciled against the statewide Total row.

reviewCharts.warning: Iowa review rows compare President to the aggregate of U.S. House district contests by county; counties are assigned through the official congressional district county tables in the canvass PDF.

turnout.notes: Iowa Secretary of State turnout report gives county Election Day voters, absentee voters, total voters, active voters as of 11/5/2024, inactive voters as of 11/5/2024, and turnout percentages. The app uses active plus inactive voters as the registered-voter denominator and warning-labels rows because the denominator is an Election Day snapshot.

certifiedResults.title: Iowa official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County presidential totals are parsed from the Iowa Secretary of State 2024 General Election canvass summary PDF, using the President and Vice President county Total rows and reconciling them to the statewide Total row.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Iowa Secretary of State canvass summary identifies the 2024 General Election held November 5, 2024 and a canvass date of December 2, 2024. Local copy was collected from the Iowa state board meeting attachment because the SOS CDN blocks command-line downloads.

wardDetail.title: Iowa county review comparison
wardDetail.detail: County review rows are loaded from the same Iowa Secretary of State 2024 General Election canvass summary PDF by comparing President and Vice President county totals to U.S. House district county totals aggregated across all four congressional districts. This is county-level and carries a methodology warning because it is not a single statewide down-ballot race.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Iowa Secretary of State canvass summary identifies the 2024 General Election held November 5, 2024 and a canvass date of December 2, 2024.

turnout.title: Iowa official county turnout
turnout.detail: County turnout rows are parsed from the Iowa Secretary of State 2024 General Election Turnout Report. The report gives Election Day voters, absentee voters, total voters, active voters, inactive voters, and turnout percentages by county.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Report title: 2024 General Election Turnout Report; registration columns are labeled as of 11/5/2024.

sourceInventory.confidence: Official Iowa Secretary of State statewide canvass summary PDF, collected from the Iowa state board meeting attachment copy when the SOS CDN blocked command-line download.

sourceInventory.usedFor: Iowa county-level review warning rows comparing President to aggregate U.S. House district totals.
sourceInventory.confidence: Official Iowa Secretary of State statewide canvass summary PDF. Methodology warning is required because the comparison sums district contests rather than using one statewide down-ballot race.

sourceInventory.usedFor: Iowa county turnout graph and coverage rows.
sourceInventory.confidence: Official Iowa Secretary of State turnout report; local CSV is derived from the official PDF text because the SOS CDN blocks command-line and browser downloads. Parsed county rows reconcile to the published Total row.

checkedNotUsable.reason: Superseded for Iowa by the official Iowa Secretary of State 2024 General Election canvass summary PDF.
checkedNotUsable.nextStep: Keep the official canvass PDF parser as the authoritative Iowa presidential county source.

turnoutPolicy.acceptedSource: Iowa Secretary of State 2024 General Election Turnout Report.
turnoutPolicy.warning: Iowa turnout uses active plus inactive voters as of November 5, 2024 from the official turnout report as the denominator. Rows are warning-labeled because the denominator is an Election Day snapshot and active-voter turnout can exceed 100% when inactive voters or new county registrants participate.
